status: PREPARED. NOT APPROVED. NOT EXECUTED. No Palace solve and no QMHP static solve has been run for this test; no refined QMHP mesh exists at the time this file was frozen.
question: Under nested Palace box refinement of the island-gap-port region (levels 0, 1, 2 of the committed L2 mesh), does Palace's band first moment move with the static quantity computed on the SAME meshes, as the spectral-moment identity predicts, and by how much do both move?

theory.lumped_port_theorem: For the declared LUMPED inductor (rank-one port term f f^T/L) and a port whose Dirichlet voltage is 1: N = sum p = 1; sum over all modes of p/lambda = L C_h; hence S_h = 1/(L C_h) is exactly the participation-weighted HARMONIC mean of lambda over the complete spectrum, and S_h <= B_k/N_k for every truncation to the lowest k modes (Cauchy-Schwarz). Verified to 1e-12 on synthetic geometries (static-band-pairing.md section 3).
theory.palace_port: Palace assembles the port as a distributed sheet, int (1/L_s)|E_t|^2 over the face. For it the first-moment Parseval identity still holds exactly, but the -1 moment is perturbed: delta = S_h * sum p/lambda - 1 was +2.3 % and +3.0 % on synthetic slabs and is at least +6.6e-4 on the committed L2 mesh (band only). S_h <= B_k/N_k is therefore not guaranteed for Palace's pencil.
theory.lumped_reduction: In a lumped two-node reduction B/S -> C_FF (C^-1)_FF = 1/(1 - k^2): the ratio S/B is NOT expected to converge to 1 but to 1 - k^2_eff, further perturbed by delta. The committed rungs show H/B = 0.991-0.996.
theory.prediction_not_target: The co-movement is a PREDICTION of this theory. S_h is computed without reading any band value; the windows below were fixed before any refined QMHP mesh or value existed.

box.why: island bbox [-0.675,-0.075]..[-0.525,0.075] at z = 0, widened by 0.025 mm (the whole 0.020 mm gap to the ground edge) and down to 0.010 mm below the port face (y = -0.115); z within one gap width. Palace marks an element if any vertex is inside (geodata.cpp) and splits it into 8 with conforming closure.

palace_deltas.Model.Refinement.Boxes: levels 1 and 2 only: one box, Levels = level

measured.per_level: S_h (static, GHz^2), C_h (fF), B_h = sum|p| f^2 / sum|p| over the 6 saved modes, H_h = 1/sum(|p|/f^2), N_B, f1, the Palace DOF count

decisive.g: S_2 / S_0 (static growth, the power condition)
decisive.r_h: S_h / B_h at each level; drift = max_h |r_h - r_0|

measured.descriptive_never_decisive: B_2/B_0, H_2/H_0, level-to-level differences and their ratio, a three-point extrapolation (valid only in the asymptotic regime), the rigorous one-sided bound S_continuum >= S_2 of the meshed model (nesting verified), and e^2/(2 C_2) as a lower bound on E_C,F1F1 under assumption A-R

relation_to_registered_E_C: Unchanged from the static-anchor pre-declaration: e^2/(2 C_h) <= e^2/(2 C_FF) <= E_C,F1F1 under A-R, with the Schur gap 1/(1 - k^2) unmeasured. In the lumped reduction B corresponds to (C^-1)_FF / L_F, H to 1/(C_FF L_F). E_C,F1F1 and g stay UNAVAILABLE; nothing here is combined with the conditional Route A coupling.

integrity.meaning: Any failure makes the record UNQUALIFIED: no verdict is read. So does a missing, non-finite or non-positive decisive value, an unverified nesting step, a digest mismatch, or a level that did not complete.

table: g < 1.05: UNRESOLVED (LOW POWER) - the box refinement did not move the static quantity by 5 %, so co-movement cannot be distinguished from no movement; the static error then lies outside the box
g >= 1.05, max|delta| <= 0.01 and drift <= 0.01: SUPPORTS - Palace's band moves with the static quantity on the same meshes and its sheet port stays within 1 % of the lumped element in the -1 moment
g >= 1.05 and (max|delta| > 0.03 or drift > 0.03): CONTRADICTS - the band and the static quantity decouple, or Palace's sheet port departs from the lumped element by more than 3 %
outcomes.why_these_windows: The lumped theory allows r_h to change only through the band's dispersion (H/B moved by at most 0.5 % across the committed rungs) and delta; 1 % gives that margin. 3 % is the sheet-vs-lumped perturbation of a synthetic port face comparable to the whole structure, i.e. a Palace port that no longer behaves as a lumped element. 5 % static growth is a fifth of what one uniform refinement produced (x1.39).
outcomes.power: Stated before the result: SUPPORTS needs the static quantity to move; if the box misses the region carrying the static error the test returns LOW POWER, not SUPPORTS.

dof_estimate.basis: ideal 8x growth of 1880 marked tets, times the 1.4-2.4x closure factor measured on the N1R/N2R port box

feasibility.time_estimate: level 0 about 80 s (L2 record), level 1 about 3 min, level 2 about 10-17 min (N2R: 103k DOF in 159 s, scaled as DOF^1.3); static solves seconds; image build as the ladder
feasibility.level3: 1.3M-2.9M DOF: infeasible on the runner; not part of this test
